NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DEFEND.title: Defend
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_DANCE.title: Sakura Dance
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_DANCE.descript: When you draw this card, [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost and rightmost Orbs.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_STRIKE.title: Strike
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_COURSE_CORRECTION.des:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put {PutBack:diff()} {PutBack:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]hand[/gold] on top of your draw pile.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_COURSE_CORRECTION.sel: Choose {PutBack} {PutBack:plural:card|cards} to put on top of your draw pile
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DEFENSIVE_FIRE.title: Defensive Fire
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_EMERGENCY_PLATING.des:
Gain {EmergencyPlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold] this turn.
Trigger your [gold]Plating[/gold] once.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_KAMUI_STRIKE.title: Kamui Strike
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_KAMUI_STRIKE.descript:
Gain {KamuiStrikeStrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
When drawn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ROLLING_BARRAGE.title: Rolling Barrage
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ROLLING_BARRAGE.descr:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each stack of your [gold]temporary Powers[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_BLIZZARD.title: Sakura Blizzard
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_BLIZZARD.descr:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
When drawn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD.title: Targeted Reload
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose an Orb and load a [gold]High-Explosive Shell[/gold]; or an [gold]Armor-Piercing Shell[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_THREEFOLD_TACTICS.des: Repeat {Repeat:diff()} times: deal {Damage:diff()} damage; or gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMORED_REPRISAL.desc: Whenever your [gold]Plating[/gold] triggers, deal damage equal to its stacks to a random enemy.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMOR_SUPERIORITY.des: Increase damage you deal by the ratio of your [gold]Plating[/gold] to your max HP.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DIVINE_WILL.title: Divine Will
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DIVINE_WILL.descripti: After each [gold]Choice[/gold], [gold]Evoke[/gold] your rightmost Orb once.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_NAVY_HOLIDAY.title: Naval Holiday
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_OPENING_SALVO.title: Opening Salvo
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_OPENING_SALVO.descrip: After your first Orb [gold]Evoke[/gold] each turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_RECONNAISSANCE_IN_FOR:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Then put a card from your [gold]draw pile[/gold] on top of it; or draw {Cards:diff()} card.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SACRED_TREE.title: Sacred Tree
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SACRED_TREE.descripti: Whenever you draw this card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SHELL_SELECTION.title: Shell Selection
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SHELL_SELECTION.descr: [gold]Evoke[/gold] all [gold]High-Explosive Shells[/gold]; or all [gold]Armor-Piercing Shells[/gold]; or all [gold]Type 3 Shells[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SOUL_WELCOMING.title: Soul Welcoming
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TRIPLE_VOLLEY.title: Triple Volley
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Repeatedly trigger your [gold]Plating[/gold] until you have none.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMORED_REFIT.title: Armored Refit
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_ARMORED_REFIT.descrip: Before your turn starts, convert all your [gold]Block[/gold] into [gold]Plating[/gold] for that turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_BATTLE_DISPOSITION.se: Drag cards to reorder, or select two cards in sequence to swap their positions.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_CONCENTRATED_FIRE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [gold]Focus[/gold] equal to your stacks of {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]temporary Powers[/gold]|temporary [gold]Focus[/gold]} this turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DECISIVE_BATTLE.title: Decisive Battle
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DECISIVE_BATTLE.descr:
[gold]Evoke[/gold] an Orb for each Orb [gold]Evoked[/gold] this combat.{InCombat:
([gold]Evoke[/gold] {CalculatedEvokes:diff()} Orbs)|}
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_DIVINE_DECREE.title: Divine Decree
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FALLING_PETALS.title: Falling Petals
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.title: Fate's Return
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.descript:
Put a card from your [gold]exhaust pile[/gold] on top of your draw pile (except Fate's Return).
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FATES_RETURN.selectio: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FLEET_REGROUP.title: Fleet Regroup
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_FLEET_REGROUP.descrip: At the end of your turn, you may shuffle any number of cards from your [gold]discard pile[/gold] into your [gold]draw pile[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_IAI.title: Iai
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_IAI.description:
Shuffle this card into your [gold]draw pile[/gold].
At the end of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} card.
If drawn at the end of your turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_LAST_WHITE_LIGHT.desc:
Play all cards 2 additional times this turn.
Die next turn.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_MYRIAD_REVELATIONS.de:
When making a [gold]Choice[/gold], you may choose multiple options.
Each counts as a separate [gold]Choice[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_NO_RETREAT.title: No Retreat
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_NO_RETREAT.descriptio:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
If you take unblocked attack damage this combat, die immediately.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_REINCARNATIONS_END.de:
Draw until your hand is full.
At the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_FORM.title: Sakura Form
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_FORM.descripti: After each of the first 3 cards played from your hand each turn, shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your draw pile, then draw that many.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SALVO_FIRE.title: Salvo Fire
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SALVO_FIRE.descriptio: At the end of your turn, [gold]Evoke[/gold] all your [gold]High-Explosive Shells[/gold].
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_KAGURA.title: Sakura Kagura
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_SAKURA_KAGURA.descrip: When you draw this card, [gold]Evoke[/gold] all your Orbs.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_RECONNAISSANCE_IN_FOR: Put a card from your [gold]draw pile[/gold] on top of it.
Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD_ARMOR: Load an [gold]Armor-Piercing Shell[/gold] in the selected slot.
NAGATO_SPIRE2_CARD_TARGETED_RELOAD_HIGH_: Load a [gold]High-Explosive Shell[/gold] in the selected slot.
